head: Hot Glue Sticks
for Quick Strong Bonding
hero.sub: 12 clear sticks in two sizes: large and small

feat.title: Strong Bond in Seconds
feat.sub: Melts with heat and sets in seconds once cool
feats: Large or small for your glue gun

steps.title: How to Use in 3 Steps
steps: Into the back of the gun, right size
Once the gun heats and the glue melts
For a few seconds until set

uses.title: For Crafts and Projects
uses.sub: For crafts, packing, decor and small repairs
uses.note: Melted glue is very hot, use with adult supervision
